curve.description: The elliptic curve to use. Examples: p160, p224, p256, brainpoolp256r1. The default is p160.

maclen.description: MAC length in bits for integrity protection. Must be a multiple of 8, range 0-256. Default is 80.

pwfile.description: Path to a file containing the passphrase. Empty means interactive prompt.

infile.description: Path to input file. Empty means STDIN.

outfile.description: Path to output file. Empty means STDOUT.

sigfile.description: Path to signature file for sign/verify operations. Empty means STDERR/STDIN.

public_key.description: The public key string (e.g., from seccure-key output) used for encryption or verification.

double_prompt.description: Prompt for passphrase twice to ensure correctness.

filter_mode.description: Copy data verbatim, attaching/detaching signatures if in append mode.

append_mode.description: Append signature to document or detach from end.
